title: On the existence and nonexistence of global solutions of the semilinear heat equation
summary: We consider the semilinear heat equation $$ u_t-Δu=|u|^{p-1}u,\ \ (t,x)\in\mathbb{R}^+\times\mathbb{R}^n. $$ The well-known difficulty with this problem is that the potential well method cannot be applied directly, due to the scaling invariance which leads to a potential well of zero depth. We employ the forward similarity transform to convert the equation into a new parabolic equation, so that we can apply the potential well method in weighted Sobolev spaces. As a result, we obtain a new criterion that establishes whether solutions to the heat equation blow up in finite time or exist…
